event: The six sit around a fire-bowl in the Transition Hall after the Proving Gate.
Solenne runs the Conductor low and finds the party at a register with no catalog entry.
Dayo rests against the wall, her weight held without being placed anywhere.
Miriam's notebook is closed; Vesper has nothing to make and sits with that.
Tomás keeps the Floor 21 notes in his pocket; Nadia's dulcimer case is set beside her.
Fifteen minutes in, Nadia opens her Level 11 skill window, reads, and closes it.
Nadia says the Tower's pulse; Solenne says she noticed it differently.
Nadia says it's still different since the trial chamber.
Solenne says it was always that way; Nadia hears it clean now.
Nadia asks if that is what Solenne hears all the time.
Solenne hears it through six people at once: dense, not loud.
Nadia nods and rests her hand on the dulcimer case without opening it.
An observation about Nadia's not-playing arrives in Solenne complete.
Solenne says Nadia has practiced not playing longer than she's not played.
Two years at least, she says: the not-playing was a skill she practiced.
Nadia stares, then her Brightspirit signal rings like a struck bell.
Nadia laughs for real, caught off-guard by an accurate description of herself.
Solenne laughs too: accuracy about people is sometimes funny.
Resonance Event: Laughing Storm pair complete, +5, party total 150 of 150.
Skill unlocked: Six of Six, undocumented, waiting for them specifically.
A second notice to Solenne alone: you are the instrument; hold all six and release.
The others read the party notice, each in their own way.
Dayo asks what it does; Solenne says she doesn't know yet.
Tomás says the Tower will recognize the moment: it reads the situation.
Miriam says: good.
Nadia asks if this is what Solenne meant: all of them at once. Solenne thinks so.
Nadia takes the dulcimer out and holds it across her knees.
She does not play; she puts it back, fastens the case, and shoulders it. Okay.
A stranger who has watched seven minutes announces herself: Cassia Renard.
Solenne had felt her arrive four minutes before and said nothing.
Cassia says she works with Apex Syndicate, watching them since Floor 11.
She tracked them through public records and System logs.
Nadia asks what she looks for; rare Harmony parties: theirs is the first six-Aspect one.
Miriam asks how many she missed; Cassia says probably none at this depth.
Dayo asks what she wants.
Access to the mechanics: how the Conductor reads composite resonance.
Cassia lays down a Floors 21-35 schematic and a resource package.
Solenne sets Vasic's paper on the floor between them.
Cassia pauses three seconds and asks where they got it.
Solenne says Floor 14's rest floor, from Dr. Petra Vasic.
Tomás names the coordinates: Floor 17, quadrant NW, alcove 7-B; they've been past it.
Cassia says they have a way to access it; Solenne says yes.
Cassia recognizes the new skill as Six of Six.
Apex modelled it three years; she was in the minority that thought it real.
Nadia says she was right; Cassia, unguarded for once, says yes, she was.
Cassia studies the paper's unknown script and admits she doesn't know the Node's contents.
She asks only for a standing agreement to work with Apex on the Conductor.
Tomás asks what Apex offers: updated maps, the package, a corridor to Floor 17.
Solenne looks at the party and says yes.
Cassia hands back Vasic's paper for when they go back, and leaves.
Tomás reads the new schematic; Vesper assesses the resource package.
Miriam writes in her notebook's main text for the first time since the Gate.
Dayo looks at the plain white door to Floor 21.
Tomás folds the schematic: same formation, open passage at entry.
Nadia shoulders the dulcimer; she will open the skill window again eventually.
Solenne files the six of them under: this, and picks up her pack.
Dayo studies the door's seam, then opens it on clean, even light.
Tomás calls formation three, and they walk through.
